diagnostics.message:
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The Kubernetes add-ons module is launched without the configured data-plane wait value, so it can install add-ons before the managed node group is ready. Wire the node-group ARN into data_plane_wait_arn to make the existing dataplane wait gate it.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The root Kubernetes-addons module is not gated on the managed node group becoming available. This example provisions add-ons that expect a usable EKS data plane, and its data_plane_wait_arn input is left at its empty default rather than being wired to the node-group output. Make the module wait for the managed node group before deploying add-ons.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The stateful example enables EKS managed node groups but does not pass their ARN through data_plane_wait_arn or otherwise order Kubernetes add-on deployment after the managed node group. Add-ons may begin before worker nodes are available, affecting workload scheduling and data-plane-dependent add-ons.
